texts.preamble: Kandibanda Mallikharjuna Rao, vs The State Of A.P. on 25 September, 2023 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Gannamaneni Ramakrishna Prasad Writ Petition No.24776 of 2020 Oral Order:
texts.arguments: Counsel for the Writ Petitioner would submit that the issue involved in the present Writ Petition is covered by an Order of the Division Bench of this Court in W.P.No.30185 of 2021 and batch, dated 24.03.2023. Counsel for the Writ Petitioner has also submitted that the Government of Andhra Pradesh has preferred an Appeal by way of a Special Leave Petition (C) Nos.9690 and 16596 of 2023 before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and that the Hon'ble Supreme Court has issued Notice in SLP (C) Nos.9690 and 16596 of 2023. Counsel for the Writ Petitioner would submit that since there is no stay of the Order of the Division Bench in W.P.No.30185 of 2021 and batch, dated 24.03.2023, the present Writ Petition must be allowed.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Counsel for the Writ Petitioner would submit that the issue involved in the present Writ Petition is covered by an Order of the Division Bench of this Court in W.P.No.30185 of 2021 and batch, dated 24.03.2023. Counsel for the Writ Petitioner has also submitted that the Government of Andhra Pradesh has preferred an Appeal by way of a Special Leave Petition (C) Nos.9690 and 16596 of 2023 before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and that the Hon'ble Supreme Court has issued Notice in SLP (C) Nos.9690 and 16596 of 2023. Counsel for the Writ Petitioner would submit that since there is no stay of the Order of the Division Bench in W.P.No.30185 of 2021 and batch, dated 24.03.2023, the present Writ Petition must be allowed.
